text: Picked up the PC's undertone handoff on the Mac: repo already at 0.4.0 (d980922), bridge restarted detached from the repo on 0.4.0 (no sources here, as expected); next pick is roadmap Next #1 timesheets (waiting on TS-logs) or #2 the self-starting bridge
undertone engines: after a first listen the user leans Synth ('very clean'), not final yet

TS-logs: undertone timesheets come from a small daily summary per machine (per project: minutes worked, blocked on you, broken by check, counts), synced through the brain repo; raw logs stay local. A real DB waits until the home dashboard needs queries. The user wants data only when it isn't noise

undertone 0.6.0 (aab90b6): the first session starts the bridge detached via bridge/launch.mjs (log ~/.undertone/bridge.log); an --auto bridge leaves after a quiet hour (no Claude lanes, no page, no sources); /undertone stop leaves ~/.undertone/stopped until /undertone or npm start; setting bridge: auto|manual

undertone 0.6 on the PC: update (claude plugin marketplace update coter-kit, then claude plugin update undertone@coter-kit), close any old bridge window, start a session and confirm a detached bridge comes up (the Windows detached start is proven only in tests so far)
done: the self-starting bridge shipped in 0.6.0; the Mac runs it detached from the repo (PID 20966) and its plugin is updated to 0.6.0
